description: How the venue can use its own address (e.g. book.yourgym.com) for its booking pages. Available on the Pro plan; the owner switches it on in Settings → Link and domain after adding the DNS record. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.
